verdict.rationale: Docs reference general 'multi-language SDK support' for the embedding API (lancedb-docs-13) and community evidence confirms a JS/TS npm package (lancedb-comm-1), implying at least Python and TypeScript SDKs exist, but the evidence pack contains no explicit confirmation of official Go or Java SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Go SDK, explicit documentation of Java SDK, and any first-party page listing all four languages together.
